title: 2BR Pet-Friendly Grayton Beach Rental Close to the Beach
meta_description: Grove To Grayt, a pet-friendly 2BR, 1BA home in Grayton Beach, FL, that is close to the beach, with four bikes, beach towels, and a firepit and chairs. Sleeps 4.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love- Close to the beach - Four bicycles included- Beach towels included- Vibrant, vintage-inspired design- Spacious and open layout- Laundry room- Propane grill - Outdoor firepit and chairs- Pet-Friendly Home (Pets must be approved and there is a $200 pet fee)Grove to Grayt is classic mid-century architecture with a refreshing beachy vibe. Located within the charming, historic village of Grayton Beach, this two-bedroom home offers plenty of peace and quiet while still keeping you close to the local attractions, too. This particular home was initially located in Seagrove, and the owners moved it here to preserve its classic old Florida feel.The home sits back from the road, allowing plenty of lounging space in the front yard. The main walkway leads up to the front door, which opens into the hallway and out into the wide-open living area. Large, sparkling walls of windows allow for plenty of gorgeous natural Florida sunshine to flow inside.On one side of the GREAT ROOM, there is a fully-equipped KITCHEN with crisp white cabinets and glossy quartz countertops. Open shelving in front of the windows catches and reflects the light off the glassware. There’s also a spacious center island with bar stool seating, a high-end gas range, a huge, double-front refrigerator, and a dishwasher. A wine fridge and stand alone ice maker across the way makes it easy to mix drinks for your friends and family.Next to the kitchen is the LIVING AREA, complete with a large HDTV that sits in front of a comfy sectional sofa and a stylish leather armchair. There’s also a full DINING ROOM with seating for six, right next to the living area, and a spacious LAUNDRY ROOM just off the kitchen.Each of the two separate bedrooms is located down a short hallway. The FIRST BEDROOM has a luxurious king-size bed and an HDTV, while the SECOND BEDROOM has an inviting queen-size bed and an HDTV. Across the hallway from both bedrooms is the single FULL BATHROOM, with a tub/shower combo and a quirky, flamingo wallpaper.In the backyard, there’s a gas barbecue for grilling out under the stars, while in the front yard, there’s a relaxing firepit for gathering around with a bottle of wine and some good conversation. And when it’s time to hit the surf and the sand, the beautiful beach is only a quick stroll or a bike ride away.MAIN FLOOR: (Sleeps 4)PRIMARY BEDROOM: king-size bed (Sleeps 2)GUEST BEDROOM: queen-size bed, (Sleeps 2)LIVING AREAKITCHENLAUNDRY ROOMFULL BATHROOM
